about: A unified diff from before to after for the source view of a proposal: '--- a/<name>', '+++ b/<name>' (name defaults to 'note.md'), then hunks with three lines of context; changed lines closer than 2 × 3 unchanged lines share a hunk. Lines are split at '\n'; the lines both texts share at their start and end are left out of the Myers diff. A hunk header gives a count only when it is not 1 ('@@ -3 +3,2 @@'); a count of 0 gives the line before. '' when the texts are the same; otherwise the diff ends with '\n'. input: { before, after, name? } → expected string.
